scope: Current planet work is restricted to examples visible in the screenshots. Whole components and per-example source evidence remain separate from historical extensions. Historical canopy matching remains failed and stopped.

requirements.requirement: Build a reusable dictionary of parts and show the exact dictionary geometry in the gallery.
requirements.clarification: User clarified that a part means a complete body or ring, potentially containing many blocks. The old 203-entry library is a block asset library, not the intended component dictionary.

requirements.requirement: Account for actual assembled geometry and silhouette; pane height, arm width and thickness must remain literal block dimensions.
Keep all pane connection states inspectable and label actual mesh bounds, not only occupied cells.
Include full glass blocks alongside panes, with original texture alpha and correct opaque/transparent ordering.
Keep geometry, texture/colour, transparency and emission distinct; colour alone does not imply emission.
Provide different glass colours for breaking up the eventual perceived silhouette; evaluate their arrangement during planet assembly.
requirements.clarification: User subsequently specified that small planets need no mixed panes and full glass is mainly relevant to larger planets. Keep earlier comparisons as history; small generated rings use one pane colour.

requirements.requirement: Show native textures, luminous and non-luminous cores at actual block scale alongside a reference cube.
Allow orbit/zoom, front/side/below inspection, dark/neutral background comparison, and individual part inspection.
Preserve existing generators, star data formats, accepted lighting formula and user settings. Keep gallery preferences separate.
Report the asset version, executed verification and remaining appearance limitations; do not claim a planet or canopy match from a parts gallery.
A planet selects one whole body and optionally one whole ring. Preserve the component identity and original cell arrangement; distinguish component count from block count.
Reject body/ring cell overlaps instead of resizing or deleting blocks. Resolve pane connections from assembled neighbours, with the same upright geometry and a shared mounting origin.

Inspect authored examples before procedural generation. Compare colours on identical cells and compare panes/full glass with the same palette, camera angle, depth and scale. Describe colour changes as changes to perceived outline, not physical bounds.

Inspect connected full glass as well as isolated assets. Remove same-material internal full-glass faces; preserve interfaces between different glass colours. Record limitations of transparent face sorting and source lighting.
Small generated planets use single-colour pane rings; keep full glass and mixed-pane examples available separately.
Provide a two-block-high surround as a whole ring component. Keep the one-high option for tall bodies and show their actual shapes at equal scale.
requirements.source: Accepted next step following the user's tall-body/ring-height question
requirements.clarification: The earlier one-high/tall-body comparison remains historical. New tall family pairs the two-high body with its full-height surround.

requirements.requirement: Choose complete compatible components and materials reproducibly by seed. Keep choice streams independent and existing item indices stable when count changes; probabilities are not quotas.
requirements.source: Authorized procedural assembly plan and explicit implementation contract
requirements.clarification: Earlier independent choice controls remain historical. New selection independently hashes family and palette; the family fixes the body/ring pairing. Materials and pane colours stay coupled within an inspected palette.

requirements.requirement: Label generated choices and permit inspecting each exact result, including material, emission, actual dimensions, component count and block count.
Pane connections depend on block attachment rules, not rendered cube bounds. Honey, jack-o'-lantern and pumpkin do not accept inward pane arms; pane-to-pane connections remain intact.
requirements.source: User attachment correction; installed client connection exceptions and honey support shape

requirements.requirement: Inspection lighting must not let neighbouring gallery planets alter one another's apparent emission. Keep the existing light formula and document renderer limitations.
requirements.source: Assistant inspection finding while adding seeded luminous/unlit examples

requirements.requirement: Avoid vertical rings in new planet studies and generation. Prioritize appearance from below; individual pane blocks remain upright. Preserve earlier vertical experiments as history.
requirements.source: Explicit user correction: avoid vertical rings, they dont look good from below

requirements.requirement: Base reference studies on identified screenshot examples. Separate visible observations from inferred hidden geometry/materials, and label new designs as extensions rather than reconstructions.
requirements.source: User questions exposed unsupported reference claims; authorized continuation of reference-led studies

requirements.requirement: Expand actual body and ring arrangements, not merely material permutations. Report distinct shape counts separately from family and palette counts.
requirements.source: User identified only two current body options; authorized further shape studies
requirements.clarification: Current screenshot-only scope supersedes inventing extra shapes to increase variety. Shape count is descriptive, not a target or quota.

requirements.requirement: Select complete inspected body/ring pairings and their authored palettes in the new generator. Cell overlap is only a geometric check, not evidence that a combination looks like a planet. Keep excluded studies inspectable.
requirements.source: Authorized complete-study workflow following the premature independent-combination experiment

requirements.requirement: Respect source-model pane end-face culling for connected same-material panes. Retain untagged faces and differing-material interfaces; distinguish this rendering correction from geometry or lighting changes.
requirements.source: Native inspection found duplicate touching pane end caps

requirements.requirement: Focus current planet studies and generation on planets seen in the screenshots. Hide invented body/ring extensions and unsupported palette swaps from the default active set; retain them as labelled history.
requirements.source: User: just focus on the planets seen in the screenshots for now
